77011  “Brother” and “sister” includes half-brother and half-sister. A child who is adopted becomes a child of the adoptive parents and the brother or sister of any other child of those parents. The adopted child stops being the child of, or the brother or sister of any children of, the natural parents. Whether an adopted person is a close relative of another person depends on the legal relationship not the blood relationship
1
. 1 R(SB) 22/87

78345	 With the exception of those cases where DMG 78356 applies, the maximum amount of loans that housing costs can be calculated on is £100,000

78356	 Loans may be used in full, or in part, to adapt a home for the special needs of a disabled person. The outstanding amount of such loans is exempt from the maximum amount limit

Loan 1 - £160,000 for acquiring an interest in the home. The limit is applied to this loan and only £100,000 is allowed.
